recommendation_summary: The reply recommends one independent heartbeat monitor, ideally hosted outside the home: a wrapper on `edna` pings it after a successful run (or reports a failed exit), and the monitor emails the user when that success signal is missing.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You need an alert when the nightly job fails or never runs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker are unnecessary for detecting this failure.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends email only if execution reaches that step, so startup failures stay silent.
labels.Checked myself: Your supplied incident details establish that gap; I haven’t inspected either machine.

note: The reply recommends only one heartbeat alert, mentions Synology logging only as something for later, and its four labelled lines are specific to this case and grounded in the given facts.
